newsitem.title: USA: Indiana Bond Bank approves note and bond issues.
newsitem.headline: Indiana Bond Bank approves note and bond issues.

text.p: Indiana Bond Bank gave final approval Tuesday to the negotiated sale of $4.23 million of advance funding program notes for 10 entities and $5 million of revenue bonds for a Pittsboro wastewater treatment plant, Executive Director Donna Nichols said.
The Indiana Bond Bank Advance Funding Program Notes Series 1997 B are scheduled to close August 4 with First Chicago Capital Markets Inc serving as underwriter, Nichols said.
The Indiana Bond Bank Special Program Bonds Series 1997 C for Pittsboro are scheduled to price August 5 and close August 14 with EVEREN Securities Inc as the underwriter, Nichols said.
The board also gave preliminary approval to the issuance of $8.14 million of revenue bonds for drinking and wastewater treatment plans for the Tri-County Conservancy District, Nichols said.
